versions.changelog:
- Added a license field (MIT) to the skill metadata.
- Expanded documentation to include guidance on finding endpoint and type docs using go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Improved error handling notes for HTTP errors.
- Removed redundant setup or skill-card documentation files.

- Removed the file skill-card.md to streamline documentation. No changes to functionality or user-facing behavior.
- All existing usage, permissions, and setup remain unchanged.

Initial release of go-valtown skill.

- Adds support for managing Val Town API resources from Go using the `github.com/psyb0t/go-valtown` package.
- Enables typed, authenticated access to vals, branches, files, blobs, environment variables, SQLite, email, users, orgs, and aliases.
- Guides Go API integration with secure token handling and response decoding.
- Includes examples for authentication, retrieving user info, listing vals, and running SQLite queries.
- Describes when and when not to use this client within Go projects.
